arxiv-1811-03773.title: A Fully Automated System for Sizing Nasal PAP Masks Using Facial Photographs
arxiv-1811-03773.creator: Benjamin Johnston Student Member, IEEE, Philip de Chazal Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-1811-03773.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Benjamin Johnston Student Member, IEEE, Philip de Chazal Senior Member, IEEE. We present a fully automated system for sizing nasal Positive Airway Pressure (PAP) masks. The system is comprised of a mix of HOG object detectors as well as multiple convolutional neural network stages for facial landmark detection. The models were trained using samples from the publicly available PUT and MUCT datasets while transfer learning was also employed to improve the performance of the models on facial photographs of actual PAP mask users.

arxiv-2110-01284.title: Prolog as a Querying Language for MongoDB
arxiv-2110-01284.creator: Daniel Beßler, Sascha Jongebloed, Michael Beetz
arxiv-2110-01284.description: Abstract Today’s database systems have shown to be capable of supporting AI applications that demand a lot of data processing. To this end, these systems incorporate powerful querying languages that go far beyond the mere retrieval of data, and provide sophisticated facilities for data processing as well.

arxiv-2209-13602.title: Black hole microstate counting from the gravitational path integral
arxiv-2209-13602.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by . Reproducing the integer count of black hole micro-states from the gravitational path integral is an important problem in quantum gravity. In this paper, we show that, by using supersymmetric localization, the gravitational path integral for 1 8 \frac{1}{8} -BPS black holes in 𝒩 = 8 \mathcal{N}=8 supergravity reproduces the index obtained in the string theory construction of such black holes, including all non-perturbatively suppressed geometries.

arxiv-2309-14167.title: Ultrafast Demagnetization through Femtosecond Generation of Non-thermal Magnons
arxiv-2309-14167.creator: Markus Weißenhofer, Peter M. Oppeneer
arxiv-2309-14167.description: Abstract Ultrafast laser excitation of ferromagnetic metals gives rise to correlated, highly non-equilibrium dynamics of electrons, spins and lattice, which are, however, poorly described by the widely-used three-temperature model (3TM). Here, we develop a fully ab-initio parameterized out-of-equilibrium theory based on a quantum kinetic approach–termed (N+2) temperature model –that describes magnon occupation dynamics due to electron-magnon scattering.

arxiv-2312-08764.title: CattleEyeView: A Multi-task Top-down View Cattle Dataset for Smarter Precision Livestock Farming
arxiv-2312-08764.creator: Kian Eng Ong 1 ‡, Sivaji Retta 2 ‡, Ramarajulu Srinivasan 2 ‡@, Shawn Tan 2, Jun Liu 1
arxiv-2312-08764.description: Abstract Cattle farming is one of the important and profitable agricultural industries. Employing intelligent automated precision livestock farming systems that can count animals, track the animals and their poses will raise productivity and significantly reduce the heavy burden on its already limited labor pool.

arxiv-2504-08837.title: VL-Rethinker: Incentivizing Self-Reflection of Vision-Language Models with Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2504-08837.creator: Haozhe Wang, Chao Qu, Zuming Huang, Wei Chu, Fangzhen Lin, Wenhu Chen
arxiv-2504-08837.description: Abstract Recently, slow-thinking systems like GPT-o1 and DeepSeek-R1 have demonstrated great potential in solving challenging problems through explicit reflection. They significantly outperform the best fast-thinking models, such as GPT-4o, on various math and science benchmarks. However, their multimodal reasoning capabilities remain on par with fast-thinking models.

arxiv-2506-18971.title: The OATMEAL Survey. II. The 3D spin-orbit obliquity of an eccentric transiting brown dwarf in the Ruprecht 147 open cluster
arxiv-2506-18971.creator: Theron W. Carmichael, Steven Giacalone, Noah Vowell, Daniel Huber, Xian-Yu Wang, Malik Bossett, Luke Handley, Aaron Householder, Yaguang Li, Benjamin J. Fulton, Andrew Howard, Howard Isaacson, Samuel Halverson, Arpita Roy

Carmichael, Steven Giacalone, Noah Vowell, Daniel Huber, Xian-Yu Wang, Malik Bossett, Luke Handley, Aaron Householder, Yaguang Li, Benjamin J. Fulton, Andrew Howard, Howard Isaacson, Samuel Halverson, Arpita Roy. arxiv-2508-06440.title: Multiorbital character of the density wave instability in La 4 Ni 3 O 10
arxiv-2508-06440.creator: Abhi Suthar, Vignesh Sundaramurthy, Matías Bejas, Congcong Le, Pascal Puphal, Pablo Sosa-Lizama, Armin Schulz, Jürgen Nuss, Masahiko Isobe, Peter A. van Aken, Y. Eren Suyolcu, Matteo Minola, Andreas P. Schnyder, Xianxin Wu, Bernhard Keimer, Giniyat Khaliullin, Andrés Greco, Matthias Hepting
arxiv-2508-06440.description: Abstract Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates exhibit high-temperature superconductivity closely intertwined with charge and spin density wave order. However, fundamental questions persist regarding the interplay between the associated density wave (DW) fluctuations and superconductivity, as well as the orbital character and symmetry underlying the DW instabilities.

arxiv-2510-23392.title: Sturm-Liouville problems on graphs with Robin boundary conditions
arxiv-2510-23392.creator: Yuri Latushkin, Vyacheslav Pivovarchik, Alesia Supranovych
arxiv-2510-23392.description: Abstract . We study characteristic functions and describe asymptotics of the eigenvalues for the spectral Sturm-Liouville problem on graphs equipped with Robin-Kirhhoff boundary conditions. Also, we show how to recover the coefficients in the Robin conditions for the quantum graphs provided the shape of the graphs and some Robin eigenvalues are known.

arxiv-2510-24106.title: UniField: Joint Multi-Domain Training for Universal Surface Pressure Modeling
arxiv-2510-24106.creator: Junhong Zou 1,2 Zhenxu Sun 3 Wei Qiu 3 Zhaoxiang Zhang 1,2 Zhen Lei 1,2 Xiangyu Zhu 1,2 1 MAIS, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, China, 2 School of Artificial Intelligence, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, China, 3 Key Laboratory for Mechanics in Flui
arxiv-2510-24106.description: Abstract Aerodynamic simulation of the surface pressure field around objects is crucial for many engineering problems. In recent years, deep neural networks have emerged as an efficient alternative to traditional, computationally expensive CFD simulations for modeling surface pressure fields. However, data scarcity remains a fundamental challenge, limiting the application of neural networks.

arxiv-2511-05025.title: 8bit-GPT: Exploring Human-AI Interaction on Obsolete Macintosh Operating Systems
arxiv-2511-05025.creator: Hala Sheta
arxiv-2511-05025.description: Abstract The proliferation of assistive chatbots offering efficient, personalized communication has driven widespread over-reliance on them for decision-making, information-seeking and everyday tasks. This dependence was found to have adverse consequences on information retention as well as lead to superficial emotional attachment [ 12 ] .

arxiv-2512-05783.title: Curvature-Regularized Variational Autoencoder for 3D Scene Reconstruction from Sparse Depth
arxiv-2512-05783.creator: Maryam Yousefi, Soodeh Bakhshandeh
arxiv-2512-05783.description: Abstract When depth sensors provide only 5% of needed measurements, reconstructing complete 3D scenes becomes difficult. Autonomous vehicles and robots cannot tolerate the geometric errors that sparse reconstruction introduces. We propose curvature regularization through a discrete Laplacian operator, achieving 18.1% better reconstruction accuracy than standard variational autoencoders.

pmc-10572056.title: Multi-Trait Single-Step Genomic Prediction for Milk Yield and Milk Components for Polish Holstein Population
pmc-10572056.creator: Hasan Önder, Beata Sitskowska, Burcu Kurnaz, Dariusz Piwczyński, Magdalena Kolenda, Uğur Şen, Cem Tırınk, Demet Çanga Boğa, Donata Marletta
pmc-10572056.description: Simple SummaryThe objective of our study was to evaluate the predictive ability of a multi-trait genomic prediction model to estimate heritability and genetic correlations of traits such as 305-day milk yield, milk fat percentage, milk protein percentage, milk lactose percentage, and milk dry matter percentage in the Polish Holstein population. Results showed that strong accuracies for the predictions were achieved.

pmc-10862094.title: A Mixed Model Approach for Estimating the Optimal Food Fortification of Vitamin D: Experiment Based on Mashhad Cohort Study in Iran
pmc-10862094.creator: Marjan Pourmohamadkhan, Zahra Khorasanchi, Hamideh Ghazizadeh, Atefeh Sedighnia, Behzad Kiani, Omid salemi, Gordon Ferns, Sharareh Rostam Niakan Kalhori, Majid Ghayour-Mobarhan
pmc-10862094.description: Background: Vitamin D deficiency is a prevalent problem in worldwide healthcare related to several system disorders. Food fortification as a solution is associated with several challenges including insufficient coverage of the entire population, required degree of fortification, the vehicles used for fortification and potential toxicity.

pmc-11512529.title: Evaluating Physician Knowledge, Attitudes, and Practices in Screening and Supplementation for Vitamin B12 Deficiency in Type 2 Diabetes Patients Treated with Metformin
pmc-11512529.creator: Samaher Z AlSaad, Razan K AlHadlaq, Enas Fahad Alaraik, Abdullah O Alnomany, Haytham I AlSaif, Turky H Almigbal, Mohammed A Batais, Abdullah A Alrasheed
pmc-11512529.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background and AimLong-term metformin use in Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (T2DM) patients is associated with Vitamin B12 deficiency. This study aims to evaluate physicians’ knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding Vitamin B12 screening and supplementation in this context.MethodsA survey was administered to physicians across various specialties in government hospitals and primary care centers in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, from January 2019 to January 2020.

pmc-11523846.title: A measurement study of the environmental quality and medical expenditures of elderly individuals: causal inference based on machine learning
pmc-11523846.creator: Yu Zhang, Sheng Chen, Dewen Liu
pmc-11523846.description: BackgroundThe global surge of environmental pollution exacerbates health issues, disease incidence, and economic strain. In China, the increasing healthcare costs of the elderly population necessitate addressing this challenge as part of the “Healthy China” strategy. We explore the impact of environmental quality on elderly healthcare expenses.

pmc-12597608.title: Subdermally Placed Implanon Migration Into the Pectoralis Muscle and Its Removal in a Resource‐Limited Setup: A Case Report and Brief Literature Review
pmc-12597608.creator: Musie Negasi Gebreslase, Birhanu Kassie Reta, Million Abraha Zeray, Awash Solomon, Tsion Haile Woldemariam, Haftom Guesh Girmay
pmc-12597608.description: Due to their effectiveness, convenience, and reversibility, single‐rod etonogestrel devices such as Implanon and Nexplanon are increasingly popular as long‐acting reversible contraceptive methods. Despite these benefits, rare but serious side effects such as device migration can occur, making diagnosis and surgical removal challenging.

pmc-13567659.title: The Gut Microbiome as a Mechanistic Link Between the Planetary Health Diet and Healthy Aging
pmc-13567659.creator: Tamás Jarecsny, Andrea Lehoczki, Tamás Csípő, Vince Fazekas-Pongor, Noémi Mózes, Boglárka Csík, Virág Zábó, Ágnes Lipécz, Dorottya Nyáry, Mónika Fekete
pmc-13567659.description: Population aging, the rising burden of chronic non-communicable diseases, and environmental degradation are increasingly recognized as interconnected global challenges, underscoring the need for integrated strategies that simultaneously promote human and planetary health. The Planetary Health Diet (PHD), originally proposed to address these challenges, has emerged as a promising dietary framework for supporting healthy aging.
